notes:
Adds a fail-closed Shut Down to Boot Chooser action for installer-managed
Fedora + Zeus multi-OS systems. It uses one-shot UEFI BootNext, preserves
persistent BootOrder/defaults, validates the existing Fedora GRUB chooser,
and leaves normal shutdown unchanged. Installations without verified
installer provenance keep the action hidden. Version remains 0.1.0-preview.2.
